text:
All tests pass.

**Root cause:** `Text.right_crop` (used by `remove_suffix`, `rstrip_end`, and `set_length` when shrinking) updated `self._text` and `self._spans` but never updated `self._length`, so `len(text)` kept reporting the pre-crop length. Any subsequent operation relying on `len(text)` (further `set_length` calls, `append`, `stylize`) used the stale value, causing padding/cropping and span offsets to be wrong.

**Fix:** In `Text.right_crop`, after truncating the text, set `self._length = max_offset` (the new, correct length) to keep it in sync with the actual content.

final_text:
All tests pass.

**Root cause:** `Text.right_crop` (used by `remove_suffix`, `rstrip_end`, and `set_length` when shrinking) updated `self._text` and `self._spans` but never updated `self._length`, so `len(text)` kept reporting the pre-crop length. Any subsequent operation relying on `len(text)` (further `set_length` calls, `append`, `stylize`) used the stale value, causing padding/cropping and span offsets to be wrong.

**Fix:** In `Text.right_crop`, after truncating the text, set `self._length = max_offset` (the new, correct length) to keep it in sync with the actual content.
